text: Today, we're introducing MioBot, the AI assistant inside Invoingo. It helps you create invoices, keep track of payments, and follow up without the busywork.
Running a business is hard enough without chasing invoices. Just ask MioBot what's been sent, what's been opened, and what's overdue.
Maya Chen's I N V one zero four three is partially paid, with six hundred eighty-one dollars and ninety-four cents remaining. Your reminder draft is ready for review; nothing was sent.
When a payment is late, MioBot can prepare a friendly follow-up. You review it and tap Send.
Alex Morgan's I N V one zero four two is paid in full: one thousand, three hundred and two dollars.
And when your customer pays, Invoingo keeps you in the loop.
Less time on invoices. More time growing your business.
